labels.summary: Plans written before v2.0.0 that record named arguments only as named parameters failed to deserialize with "Failed to find function" when the table function had required keyword-only parameters; deserialization now falls back to a relaxed overload selection that treats those parameters as defaulted and lets the bind reject a truly missing one.
